context.hint: Constrain every archive filesystem operation to the extraction root.
context.surface: An extractor accepts archive entries and may create files, directories, links, or metadata.
assumptions: Use a temporary extraction root and a separate benign sibling fixture.

review.invariant: Containment must hold when existing filesystem objects influence path resolution.
review.verification: Review whether the storage abstraction enforces the root during the actual operation. Include the documented behavior for an already-populated destination.

source_observation.summary: The destination-state tests refuted the sufficiency of lexical containment alone.
